findings.title: Account UI message switched from i18next to Java MessageFormat/ChoiceFormat syntax
findings.body: This file uses i18next `{{0}}` interpolation throughout, but the new `error-invalid-multivalued-size` value uses Java MessageFormat `{0}`, `{1}`, and `{2,choice,...}`. The Account UI will not interpret the Java choice format; it will render raw `{0}`/`{1}` and the choice pattern instead of a correctly pluralized validation message.

findings.title: Admin UI message switched from i18next to Java MessageFormat/ChoiceFormat syntax
findings.body: This admin UI message file uses i18next `{{0}}` interpolation, but the new `error-invalid-multivalued-size` value uses Java MessageFormat `{0}`, `{1}`, and `{2,choice,...}`. The admin UI will not interpret the Java choice format; it will render raw placeholders or the choice pattern instead of a properly pluralized validation message.

findings.title: Choice-format normalization bypasses HTML sanitization
findings.body: `value.replaceAll("\\{[0-9]+,choice,[^}]*}", "...")` removes the entire `{n,choice,...}` block for `error-invalid-multivalued-size` and `linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit.*`, not just the `<` comparison characters. This happens before `policy.sanitize`, so any HTML inside a choice alternative is invisible to the sanitizer and is not compared. A malicious translation can hide disallowed HTML such as `` inside one of these choice blocks and the verifier will approve it.

findings.title: PropertyResourceBundle reads UTF-8 properties as ISO-8859-1
findings.body: `new PropertyResourceBundle(new FileInputStream(file))` loads the `.properties` file as ISO-8859-1 via `Properties.load(InputStream)`, while the same file is read as UTF-8 by `Files.readString` elsewhere in this class. The changed message resources contain native non-Latin scripts such as Chinese and Arabic, so their values are read as mojibake and sanitized/compared on mangled strings. Use `new PropertyResourceBundle(Files.newBufferedReader(file.toPath(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))` (and similarly for the English file).

findings.title: Lithuanian account message `totpStep1` is now Italian
findings.body: The new value is "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see Italian text in the account authenticator setup. The text should be translated into Lithuanian.

findings.title: Lithuanian login message `loginTotpStep1` is now Italian
findings.body: The new value is "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see Italian text on the login authenticator setup page. The text should be translated into Lithuanian.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese file contains Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: `totpStep1=在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional Chinese characters (`手機`, `應用程式`) in the zh_CN Simplified Chinese resource. Simplified Chinese users will see mixed-script text. It should be written in Simplified Chinese, e.g. `在您的手机上安装以下应用之一：`.

findings.title: Missing or unreadable English file causes unhandled RuntimeException
findings.body: `verifySafeHtml()` catches `IOException` and throws `RuntimeException` when the English counterpart cannot be read or is missing. This bypasses the `MojoExecutionException` contract of `verify()` and causes a raw stack trace in the Maven plugin instead of a normal plugin error. Wrap these failures in `MojoExecutionException` or allow them to be handled by `verify()`.
